∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup.{u_1} M] [inst_1 : Module.{0, u_1} Complex M]
  [inst_2 : LieRingModule.{0, u_1} (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x) M]
  [inst_3 : LieModule.{0, 0, u_1} Complex (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x) M]
  [FiniteDimensional.{0, u_1} Complex M] (lambda : Complex) {v : M},
  Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1}
      (Module.End.maxGenEigenspace.{0, u_1}
        (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, 1, u_1 + 1}
          (LieModule.toEnd.{0, 0, u_1} Complex (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x) M)
          Etingof.Sl2Irrep.sl2_h)
        lambda)
      v →
    Exists.{1} fun N => And (LT.lt.{0} 0 N) (Eq.{u_1 + 1} (Etingof.Sl2Irrep.fIter.{u_1} N v) 0)
